definition: User experience — the overall quality of a person’s interaction with a product; in AI systems it increasingly covers trust, transparency, and control of model behavior.
details: User experience — the overall quality of a person’s interaction with a product; in AI systems it increasingly covers trust, transparency, and control of model behavior.

explainer.lead: UX is the overall quality of a person's interaction with a product. In AI systems it increasingly covers trust, transparency and control of model behaviour.

tiers.eli5: It's how good a product feels to use — and with AI, that includes whether you trust it and can steer it.
tiers.practitioner: Designers now shape trust, transparency and user control over model behaviour, not just screens and flows. Pitfall: treating an AI feature like a normal UI element ignores uncertainty and failure modes users must see.
tiers.paperLevel: The overall quality of a person's interaction with a product; for AI systems it extends to trust, transparency and control of model behaviour.

explainer.example: An AI assistant shows its sources and lets users correct an answer, improving trust and control rather than only the visual layout.
